contract: A23-105 day: ClockTime turns once per 1440 s (Pace 5-7 120 s, 7-17 960 s, 17-19 120 s, 19-5 240 s), a step every Tick (0.5 s, <= MaxStepHours 0.025 h, always forward); DayPhase by Phases (Dawn 6-7 = 60 s, Day 7-17 = 960 s, Dusk 17-19 = 120 s, Night 19-6 = 300 s; Dawn only once the light is half up). GameState DayPhase / NightLevel ALWAYS follow the ClockTime shown, under every sky: DayPhase = PhaseOf(clock), NightLevel = LookAt(clock).Night (the night share of the time-of-day look, 2 decimals); a war sky never fixes them (Halo at 17:30 -> Dusk then Night, NightLevel rising; Horns at noon -> Day / 0); the clock shown = Lighting.ClockTime during the switch-off ease and whenever the cycle does not own the clock (fixed afternoon 15.3 = Day / 0, Dawn preset 7.2 = PhaseOf(7.2), Eclipse preset 0.5 = Night / 1), published every tick, changes only. Config.DayCycle.Enabled = false until ZoneLook C1 (night lift by NightLevel) + C2 (hollow dusk without the 6:00 jump) land (the gate group). The cycle owns the time and the Neutral look only after its Start (WarService keeps Neutral and the preset war clocks before / without it); the Neutral sky's light by the time of day (Looks / Keys, Day = Config.Sky.Neutral exactly 8-16) with Floor minimums (rain at night included); a new server starts at StartClock 15.3. War (검수 2026-10-10, user (b)): WarService Cover(sky) on Dawn / Eclipse - it tweens the look only, never the clock while the cycle runs -, the cycle keeps writing ClockTime every tick (forward, <= MaxStepHours; never a look key) under it; Uncover(TweenTime) on Neutral (one Lighting look tween, no ClockTime, toward ValuesAt of the time it ends - not the war-start look -, no look writes until it ends, the clock turning meanwhile, no jump after); a missed call is caught by the next step. Cycle off: WarService's preset clocks, forward <= ClockForwardMax 18 h (Dawn -> Eclipse +17.3 h). Switch DayCycle off: the clock eases the short way to StartClock (the look with it unless a war sky covers it). Weather: Clear / Rain (Snow instead in KST months 12/1/2), FirstClear, Clear, Chance / WinterChance, Rain / Snow seconds, a shower changes kind at KST midnight, the wet look eases over BlendSeconds (sun, exposure, fog, clouds). GameState DayPhase / NightLevel / Weather; switches DayCycle / Weather; Studio debug Clock / Weather / DayState (no player, no save); WarService writes no LightingStyle.
limitations: Lighting, TweenService (tweens finish when the test says), Clouds, Color3 and the registry are doubles; how the night and the rain LOOK (PC and phone photos), how a war sky's look reads with the sun or moon of any hour (Eclipse at noon, Dawn at midnight), Roblox's own sun / moon position for a ClockTime, replication timing and the client modules running (ZoneLook's night lift by NightLevel, WeatherFx lamps) are not here - the gate only reads ZoneLook's text and evaluates its duskOver; main-Studio photos by 메인 반영 1 with DebugCommand Clock / Weather once Enabled is true. With the cycle off, WarService's 3 s preset clock tween sweeps the sun through the hours in between (e.g. Neutral 15.3 -> Dawn 7.2 forward through the night) and DayPhase follows that shown clock tick by tick (lamps may come on for ~1-2 s).
